verified: The University of Utah team and MIT Technology Review report that Davidson is the first of nine implanted trial participants to take the nerve-connected LUKE arm home; the LUKE arm received FDA approval in 2014, but the nerve interface is experimental.
unconfirmed: Peer-reviewed results, independent measures of how much the device helps in daily life, any long-term effects on Davidson's nerves or brain, and whether other participants will use it at home; the report gives no trial completion date, success rate or commercial availability.

verified: 据《麻省理工科技评论》报道，Davidson在犹他大学临床试验中植入连接前臂神经的LUKE仿生手，是第九名植入者，也是首位将该实验设备带回家独立使用的人；他报告能感知压力并处理易碎物品。
unconfirmed: 单例居家使用的长期获益与安全性、神经信号在更长时间内的稳定性，以及结果能否推广到其他截肢者，均缺乏同行评审数据；设备价格、上市时间和更广泛可用性未披露。

titles.en: First home use of nerve-connected LUKE bionic arm with touch feedback
titles.zh: 首位受试者将LUKE仿生手带回家独立使用
